question: The first match of IPL 2022 was played in_______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mumbai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** IPL 2022**

 
 
• ​A men's **T20 **franchise cricket league in India is known as the** Indian Premier League (IPL)**.
 
• Ten teams from seven cities and three states compete in it every year.
 
• The Board of Control for **Cricket **in **India (BCCI)** established the league in **2007**. **IPL's **current chairman is **Arun Dhumal**.
 
• It typically takes place in India's warm months of **March **through **May **and has a special window in the **ICC **Future Tours Programme.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **IPL **is the cricket league with the highest attendance worldwide.
 
• It placed sixth in terms of average attendance across all sports leagues in **2014**.
 
• In **2010**, the **IPL** became the first sporting event ever to feature a live YouTube broadcast.
 
• The **IPL's **brand value in **2022 **was **90,038 crore ($11 billion)**.
